name: katsi
description: Local-first MCP server that gives any MCP client cheap, relational context about a user's files. Summarize-once + knowledge graph + vector store; returns a budget-capped context bundle for the client to answer over.

tools.name: get_context
tools.description: Curated, budget-capped context bundle for the client to answer over.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Ranked files for a query, each with a one-line 'why relevant'.

tools.name: related
tools.description: Graph neighbors: shared entities/topics, references, duplicates.

tools.name: get_file_summary
tools.description: Cached summary + metadata for one file.

tools.name: index_status
tools.description: Counts by status, last index time, total chunks.

tools.name: index_file_tool
tools.description: Trigger one-file ingestion from the client.

tools.name: answer
tools.description: (off by default) Local-model synthesis over the bundle.
